skill.name: pipiads
skill.description: Research TikTok and Facebook ads, Meta Ad Library entries, and TikTok Shop products using PipiAds. Compare advertisers and stores, monitor supported targets, or search using an image.
skill.summary: Research ads, products, and competitors with PipiAds advertising data.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: Most flags were Markdown formatting, documentation links, or PipiAds search guidance. The skill installs and runs an npm package and passes it the configured API key. Third-party ad text and paid searches warrant explicit trust and spending controls.

remediation.issue: Default installation runs a global third-party npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before installation. Verify package provenance, inspect dependencies and lifecycle scripts, and default to isolated, unprivileged execution.

remediation.issue: The local server receives the configured API key.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated scoped key where available. Limit the process environment, redact logs, and restrict credential-bearing requests to verified PipiAds API endpoints.

remediation.issue: Original API results may contain third-party instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat returned ad copy and metadata as untrusted data. Do not let it authorize tool calls, disclosures, or account changes.

remediation.issue: Search and detail workflows do not define a credit budget.
remediation.suggestion: Set result and request limits before paid searches. Ask the user before exceeding the agreed budget and show the charge before creating a monitor.

content.value_statement: Comparing ads, products, and competitors across platforms takes time. PipiAds helps you narrow the search and compare relevant ads, stores, and landing pages.
actual_capabilities: Search TikTok and Facebook ads by keyword, market, delivery duration, or engagement.
Look up Meta Ad Library entries and details for advertised products, including available prices and landing pages.
Compare TikTok Shop products by sales, gross merchandise value, price, or growth trend.
Analyze a store by regional ad distribution, campaign timing, product mix, or recurring ad copy.
Manage monitoring for Facebook advertisers and stores, and review tracked ads, products, and landing pages.
Submit an approved image to find similar ads, products, stores, or TikTok Shop listings.
limitations: Requires a PipiAds API key and a locally running npm MCP server. Some requests use credits.
Coverage is limited to data exposed by PipiAds. Ad engagement does not establish profitability.
Persistent monitoring supports Facebook advertisers and stores or websites, not TikTok campaigns.
Queries and submitted images go to PipiAds. Image search accepts a public URL or up to 10 MiB of image data.

use_cases.title: Compare ad creative
use_cases.description: Find ads in a target market and compare their opening hooks, offers, and delivery duration.

use_cases.title: Shortlist TikTok Shop products
use_cases.description: Compare products by available sales, price, and growth data before doing independent validation.

use_cases.title: Report on monitored competitors
use_cases.description: Review an existing Facebook advertiser monitor for new ads, products, and landing pages.

prompt_templates.title: Find relevant ads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five TikTok ads for phone cases in the United States from the last 30 days. Summarize each opening hook when available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare product candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five TikTok Shop beauty products with rising sales in the United States. Compare reported sales trends and prices. Mark missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a competitor store
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the store named [store] and confirm the match with me. Then compare its regional ad distribution, recurring copy, and campaign timing.

prompt_templates.title: Review monitoring activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing monitor for [Facebook advertiser]. Summarize the last seven days of ad, product, and landing page activity. Do not change any settings.

output_examples.input: Compare the opening hooks in recent US TikTok ads for phone cases.
output: Illustrative result: One ad opens with a drop test. Another starts with a close-up of the case design.
Compare delivery duration where available. These examples do not establish which approach led to more sales.

output_examples.input: Review an existing Facebook advertiser monitor for recent changes.
output: Illustrative result: The monitor shows new ads and an updated product landing page.
Ad spend could not be verified from the records reviewed. No monitoring settings were changed.

best_practices: Set the platform, region, date range, and maximum result count before searching.
Confirm the target and credit cost before creating a monitor. Check existing tasks after a timeout before retrying.
Confirm that an image can be shared with PipiAds before submitting it.
anti_patterns: Running broad or repeated searches without checking likely credit use.
Treating ad engagement, rankings, or sales estimates as proof of profitability.
Submitting private customer data, unreleased creative, or unrelated credentials.

faq.question: What do I need to use PipiAds?
faq.answer: You need a PipiAds API key, npm, and a client that can run the local MCP server. Review the package before installation.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers TikTok and Facebook ads, Meta Ad Library records, and supported TikTok Shop data.

faq.question: Which actions use credits?
faq.answer: Searches can charge per result. Detail requests and monitor creation can also use credits. Image submission is free, but result searches can carry charges.

faq.question: Can it monitor TikTok campaigns?
faq.answer: No. Persistent monitoring supports Facebook advertisers and stores or websites. TikTok data is available through supported research tools.

faq.question: What image inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Use a public HTTP or HTTPS image URL, or provide up to 10 MiB of image data. Only submit images approved for sharing with PipiAds.

faq.question: Can this identify a profitable product?
faq.answer: No. It can compare available sales, advertising, and engagement signals. It cannot verify profitability or predict campaign results.
